power_function_classify_end_behavior.display_name: Classify end behavior of f(x) = k * x^n

easy.statement_latex: Describe the end behavior of $f(x) = 2x^{5}$. State what happens to $y$ as $x \to +\infty$ and as $x \to -\infty$.
hints: For a power function, look at two things: the sign of the leading coefficient and the parity of the exponent.
If $n$ is even, both ends head the same direction. If $n$ is odd, the ends head opposite directions.
The sign of $k$ flips the whole graph across the $x$-axis.
solution_steps_latex: Because $n = 5$ is odd, the arms of the graph go in opposite directions.
Because $k = 2$ is positive, the graph is not reflected.
